question: Should `agent.wait` use the agent job registry as the sole owner for agent-run terminal state and waiters while leaving active chat runs on their current dedupe-only path?
rationale: The bounded direction is source-supported, but it intentionally changes ownership in a protected, stable core lifecycle surface and therefore requires explicit maintainer sponsorship.

options.title: Consolidate agent runs
options.body: Feed agent lifecycle and agent-dedupe terminal observations into the job registry and remove duplicate agent waiter ownership after equivalence proof.

options.title: Defer consolidation
options.body: Keep the recently landed split until operational evidence or further lifecycle work creates a stronger reason to refactor.

options.title: Broaden the registry
options.body: Include active chat runs too, accepting a larger cross-surface redesign and validation burden.

recommendation.title: Consolidate agent runs
recommendation.body: Feed agent lifecycle and agent-dedupe terminal observations into the job registry and remove duplicate agent waiter ownership after equivalence proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest current-main history across the canonical terminal contract and affected Gateway implementation paths.
